# Deferred new-mail tasks and dedup state are not reset in cleanup

Proposed investigation from current source: cleanup unregisters observers/listeners but the inspected method does not disarm/clear per-folder tasks,pending arrays or _knownNewMessages. A global tracker and JavaScript collection may make this safe; no leak,late notification or restart failure was reproduced. Check ownership and shutdown expectations before proposing a fix. Static source inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, security experiment or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Extension new-mail lifecycle questions.
